stories.title: Bengals' Burrow has back tightness but expects to play vs. Texans
stories.summary: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow said Wednesday that he is dealing with back tightness but expects to play Sunday at the Houston Texans.

stories.title: Yankees pull Judge vs. Twins due to leg tightness
stories.summary: New York Yankees star right fielder Aaron Judge was pulled for a pinch hitter in the sixth inning Wednesday.

stories.title: Raphinha bags hat trick as Barcelona score 7 to set record start
stories.summary: Barcelona sent records tumbling with a 7-2 thumping of Racing Santander to make it seven straight wins to start the season for the first time in the club's history.

stories.title: Seahawks' Darnold avoids IR but ruled out vs. Cardinals
stories.summary: The Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday's game against the Cardinals due to the glute injury he suffered in Wednesday's season-opening win.
